world: B THE LOOP IS THE DEFECT — 0 of 24 round headlines make a claim about the object. Twenty-four rounds of apparatus repair, twenty retraction entries, and the definition has not moved. ⭐ §0.2 names this exactly: rigour is the FLOOR a deliverable must clear, never the deliverable, and a programme that only kills its own claims has a perfect world model of a subject it has produced nothing about. ⚠ AND THE HONEST QUALIFIER: much of the apparatus work was NECESSARY -- R654's stamp finding and R662's power finding are real and they protect the counts that stand. What is indefensible is that the LOOP kept choosing the apparatus, 24 times running, with no gate asking whether the object had moved.
